rule: Never generalize a finding beyond its source geography.
Preserve exact name_as_reported and normalize separately.
Separate ethnomedicinal claims, in-vitro bioactivity, composition and clinical evidence.
Do not count reviews/copied web pages as independent confirmation.
Always retain value, unit, sample state, geography and source.
Preserve source taxon string; do not silently correct uncertain names.
Store identification method because culture/16S/PCR-DGGE are not equivalent.
Store metadata + paraphrased claims; do not redistribute third-party full text without permission.
HADIA-KB maps publicly documented evidence, not all community-held knowledge.
